patterns.note: The site uses a clean, spacious grid layout for case study listings, featuring larger, prominent cards for 'Featured' projects and a consistent, smaller grid for 'Our latest' projects.
A strong typographic hierarchy is established by pairing a large, high-contrast serif font for all major headings with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
The primary content areas utilize a stark white background with black text, creating high contrast, while the footer introduces a dramatic, dark purple-to-blue gradient as a visual anchor.

The header navigation bar is initially slightly taller and more spaced out, then becomes sticky and subtly condenses into a more compact form with a solid white background as the user scrolls down the page.
The footer is a full-width, dark gradient section that serves as a distinct call-to-action area, contrasting sharply with the predominantly white content sections above it.

technique_notes: The primary motion effect is a sticky header that dynamically reduces its height and tightens its spacing upon scroll, maintaining navigation visibility while optimizing for screen real estate.
Content sections are presented with generous vertical spacing, allowing elements to breathe and creating a sense of clarity and focus for each block of information.
Case study cards utilize a consistent visual treatment with a prominent image, bold title, and concise description, arranged in a responsive grid that adapts to different screen sizes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, high-contrast serif headings (~3-4x body text) with a clean, legible sans-serif body and smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (on buttons and some image elements), but the overall layout leans towards sharp corners for a crisp feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous whitespace around major sections and headings, creating a balanced and uncluttered presentation.

standout: The distinctive use of a classic, high-contrast serif font for all major headings, combined with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text, creates a sophisticated and editorial feel that elevates the content beyond a typical corporate site. The dramatic, dark gradient footer also provides a strong, memorable visual anchor.
